peoples_entry.name: Captives, Gladiators & Manhunters
peoples_entry.note: Cross-cutting enslaved castes, arena fighters, and manhunters across the continent: Voth's 74,000 Shim Blïtrit blood-reed thralls, Nazar salvage chain-gangs, and solstice sun-altar captives; Ring Sea galley oar-thralls; Span megafauna-bone myrmillos, Drum Cauldron scrap-pitfighters, Arena Hill retiarii and laurelled champions; plus coffle slave-catchers and chartered Seal-warrant bounty hunters.
